opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Application [A-362] for stay of execution and enforcement of mandate, presented to Mr. Justice Brennan, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Mr. Justice Douglas would grant stay pending decision of this Court in No. 73-1346, McLucas v. DeChamplain. Motions to expedite and consolidate with No. 73-1346 for oral argument denied.
